name: Klaven Mortwake's Journal
summary: SI:7 operatives recover Klaven Mortwake's Journal from the Defias tower. It records the Brotherhood's search for a way to raise the dead.

sections.title: A Gruesome Formula
sections.body:
The Defias tower stands along the ridges of northern Westfall. Strange shipments arrive from the shadowy borders of Duskwood, and twisted, non-human sentries guard the tower. SI:7 watched the place for a long time. In the topmost chest, they found Klaven Mortwake's journal and learned what the shipments carried.

Klaven Mortwake recorded research into alchemical ways to raise mindless undead drones. Alchemists associated with the Zanzil trolls in Stranglethorn had found a way with specialized poisons and brews. The Defias Brotherhood sought to copy their method for its own ranks.

sections.title: Intelligence for SI:7
sections.body: Master Mathias Shaw leads Stormwind's intelligence service, SI:7. He sought Mortwake's journal to trace the Brotherhood's wider alliances. The notes confirm experiments in reanimation and illicit support linking Duskwood, the Venture Company, and the Defias. For rogues serving the crown, recovering the research is a step toward mastering poisons.

faq.answer: Klaven Mortwake's Journal is a research notebook compiled by Klaven Mortwake, an operative in the Defias tower in northeastern Westfall. It holds notes on alchemical necromancy and illicit supply routes.

The journal is locked inside a Duskwood Chest on the top floor of the Defias tower in northern Westfall. Undead sentries guard it, and a key taken from one of Klaven's monstrous guards opens the chest.

faq.q: What secrets are written inside the journal?
faq.answer: The journal records that the Zanzil trolls of Stranglethorn Vale devised toxic potions that can raise and control the dead. The Defias Brotherhood was trying to acquire and use the recipe.

aliases: who do i give the journal to
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw, leader of Stormwind's SI:7 intelligence agency, wants the journal to monitor Defias logistics and teach crown operatives the dangers and uses of tactical poisons.

angles.text: As a rogue, you prove your skill in lockpicking and stealth by entering the tower and taking Mortwake's journal. The work also introduces you to brewing lethal poisons.
As an Alliance member, you give Stormwind's spymasters proof that the Defias uprising reaches beyond disgruntled laborers. The journal reveals ties to troll witch-doctors and alchemical necromancy.
